scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web "pnpm run api:dev" "pnpm run web:dev"
scripts.build: pnpm run core:build && pnpm run web:build && pnpm run extension:build
scripts.extension:verify: pnpm run extension:build && pnpm run extension:smoke
scripts.test: pnpm run test:unit && pnpm run test:integration
scripts.test:unit: pnpm run core:test:unit && pnpm run web:test:unit && pnpm run extension:test:unit && pnpm run api:test
scripts.lint: pnpm run core:lint && pnpm run web:lint && pnpm run extension:lint && pnpm run api:lint
scripts.format: pnpm run core:format && pnpm run web:format && pnpm run extension:format && pnpm run api:format
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run core:typecheck && pnpm run web:typecheck && pnpm run extension:typecheck && pnpm run api:typecheck
scripts.logs: echo API logs are printed by the running api:dev process. Use logs:debug to enable scoped debug flags.
scripts.logs:debug: echo Set LOG_LEVEL=debug and feature flags such as DEBUG_IMPORT=true, DEBUG_SESSION=true, DEBUG_PROGRESS=true, DEBUG_AUTH=true before running dev.
scripts.logs:off: echo Default logging is warn-level with feature debug flags disabled.
scripts.diagnose: pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test
scripts.ci: pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run build
scripts.release:check: pnpm run ci && pnpm run test:e2e
